articles.title: 黃仁勳正式辭任 NVIDIA CEO　即時生效　財務總監 Colette Kress 暫代
articles.summary: NVIDIA創辦人黃仁勳即時辭任，由財務總監 Colette Kress 暫代，佢做咗33年老闆先至落任。

levels.text: NVIDIA嘅創辦人黃仁勳即時辭去總裁同CEO職位，他已經做咗33年老闆。董事會而家搵財務總監 Colette Kress 暫代CEO，她同時仍然兼任財務總監。黃仁勳最近有緋聞同調查傳聞，但公司冇講明係唔係辭職原因。股價一度跌咗一成，不過11月17日嘅業績照常公布。
levels.text_en: NVIDIA's founder Jensen Huang has immediately resigned as President and CEO, after being the boss for 33 years. The board has now found CFO Colette Kress to serve as interim CEO, while she still also holds the CFO role. Jensen Huang has recently been linked to scandal and rumors of investigation, but the company has not said whether this is the reason for his resignation. The stock price once dropped by 10%, but the November 17 earnings report will be released as scheduled.

levels.text: NVIDIA創辦人黃仁勳在美國時間11月12日宣布，即時辭去總裁、行政總裁及董事會成員職務，結束長達33年的領導生涯。董事會委任財務總監Colette Kress暫代行政總裁，並同時兼任財務總監，直至選出正式繼任人為止。公司又首次設立董事會主席一職，由Harvey C. Jones出任，他曾任Synopsys行政總裁，有豐富企業管理經驗。黃仁勳近期捲入婚外情及可能涉及外國情報活動的報道，董事會早前已就此展開獨立調查，但最新公告沒有說明辭職是否與調查有關。消息公布後，NVIDIA股價一度在盤前下跌超過一成，不過公司確認11月17日的季度業績將如期公布。
levels.text_en: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang announced on November 12 (US time) that he is immediately resigning from his roles as President, CEO, and board member, ending a leadership career spanning 33 years. The board has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and she will continue to also serve as CFO, until a permanent successor is chosen. The company is also establishing a board chair position for the first time, with Harvey C. Jones taking the role; he previously served as CEO of Synopsys and has extensive corporate management experience. Jensen Huang has recently been caught up in reports of an extramarital affair and possible involvement in foreign intelligence activities, and the board had earlier launched an independent investigation into this, but the latest announcement does not clarify whether the resignation is related to the investigation. Following the announcement, NVIDIA's stock price fell more than 10% in pre-market trading at one point, but the company confirmed that the quarterly earnings report on November 17 will be released as scheduled.

levels.text:
美國 AI 晶片巨頭 NVIDIA（英偉達）於美國時間 11 月 12 日正式宣布，創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）即時辭去公司總裁、行政總裁及董事會成員職務，結束其長達 33 年的掌舵生涯。董事會同時任命現任執行副總裁兼財務總監 Colette Kress 出任臨時行政總裁，並啟動正式繼任人選的遴選程序。

▲NVIDIA 官方公佈

Colette Kress 兼任 CEO 及 CFO　董事會尋找正式接班人

NVIDIA 在官方聲明中確認，Colette Kress 將在過渡期間同時擔任臨時行政總裁、執行副總裁及財務總監，直至董事會選出正式繼任者。公司將同時考慮內部及外部候選人，目前未公布完成遴選的時間表。

Kress 於 2013 年 9 月加入 NVIDIA，至今任職超過 13 年，曾協助公司由遊戲圖像晶片供應商發展為全球主要 AI 運算平台企業。加入 NVIDIA 前，她曾在 Microsoft 及 Cisco 等科技企業擔任財務管理職位，累積近 25 年相關經驗。

NVIDIA 首設董事會主席　承諾業務不受影響

董事會同時任命 Harvey C. Jones 為公司首任董事會主席。Jones 曾擔任 Synopsys 行政總裁及執行主席，擁有超過 30 年科技企業管理與投資經驗。

Jones 表示，Kress 熟悉 NVIDIA 的客戶、營運、財務狀況及技術發展方向，董事會對她及現有管理團隊充滿信心，預期公司營運、客戶承諾及產品路線圖不會因人事變動而中斷。Kress 則表示，將在黃仁勳過去 33 年建立的基礎上，繼續推動 NVIDIA 在加速運算及人工智能領域的發展。

黃仁勳捲入婚外情及間諜風波　董事會早前啟動調查

黃仁勳近期捲入多宗爭議。《紐約時報》及其他外媒先後報道，他與前 Megaspeed 高層黃樂（Alice Huang）有婚外情，而美國情報部門懷疑黃樂與中國情報機構有關。其後再有報道指，黃仁勳曾與 NVIDIA 醫療業務副總裁 Kimberly Powell 發展關係。相關指控涉及的情報疑慮目前尚未有公開調查結論。

NVIDIA 董事會於 11 月 8 日宣布就外國情報活動相關報道展開獨立調查，並於 11 月 10 日公布由外部法律顧問協助調查。董事會當時強調，沒有理由相信美國國家安全或 NVIDIA 的商業機密已遭洩露。

NVIDIA 最新的行政總裁交接公告並未直接說明黃仁勳辭職的原因，也沒有公布調查結論，因此目前不能確認上述爭議是否構成辭任的正式原因。

股價盤前下跌　11 月 17 日財報安排不變

隨着黃仁勳去留問題發酵，NVIDIA 股價連日受壓。路透社報道，正式辭任消息公布後，公司股價在美股盤前交易一度下跌逾 10%，市場關注領導層變動會否影響 NVIDIA 與大型 AI 客戶的合作，以及未來產品發展策略。

NVIDIA 已確認，原定於美國時間 11 月 17 日公布的 2027 財政年度第三季業績將如期發表，業績電話會議安排亦維持不變。這將是黃仁勳離任後，公司管理層首次面對的重要季度業績發布。
levels.text_en:
US AI chip giant NVIDIA officially announced on November 12 (US time) that founder Jensen Huang is immediately resigning from his positions as President, CEO, and board member, ending his 33-year tenure at the helm. The board has simultaneously appointed current Executive Vice President and CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and has launched a formal process to select a permanent successor.

▲NVIDIA official announcement

Colette Kress to hold both CEO and CFO roles; board searching for permanent successor

In its official statement, NVIDIA confirmed that Colette Kress will serve concurrently as interim CEO, Executive Vice President, and CFO during the transition period, until the board selects a permanent successor. The company will consider both internal and external candidates, and has not yet announced a timeline for completing the selection process.

Kress joined NVIDIA in September 2013, and has worked there for over 13 years, having helped the company grow from a gaming graphics chip supplier into a leading global AI computing platform company. Before joining NVIDIA, she held financial management positions at tech companies including Microsoft and Cisco, accumulating nearly 25 years of related experience.

NVIDIA establishes board chair position for first time; promises business will not be affected

The board has also appointed Harvey C. Jones as the company's first-ever board chair. Jones previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys, with over 30 years of experience in tech company management and investment.

Jones said that Kress is deeply familiar with NVIDIA's customers, operations, financial condition, and technology direction, and that the board has full confidence in her and the existing management team. He expects that the company's operations, customer commitments, and product roadmap will not be disrupted by this personnel change. Kress, for her part, said she will continue building on the foundation Jensen Huang established over the past 33 years, driving NVIDIA's development in accelerated computing and artificial intelligence.

Jensen Huang embroiled in affair and espionage controversy; board had earlier launched investigation

Jensen Huang has recently been involved in multiple controversies. The New York Times and other foreign media outlets reported that he had an extramarital affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, and that US intelligence agencies suspect Alice Huang may have ties to Chinese intelligence agencies. Subsequent reports further indicated that Jensen Huang had also developed a relationship with Kimberly Powell, Vice President of NVIDIA's healthcare business. There is currently no public conclusion to the investigation regarding the intelligence concerns involved in these allegations.

NVIDIA's board announced on November 8 that it was launching an independent investigation into reports related to foreign intelligence activities, and on November 10 announced that external legal counsel would assist with the investigation. At the time, the board emphasized that there was no reason to believe that US national security or NVIDIA's trade secrets had been compromised.

NVIDIA's latest announcement on the CEO transition does not directly explain the reason for Jensen Huang's resignation, nor does it disclose the investigation's conclusions, so it cannot currently be confirmed whether the above controversies constitute the formal reason for his resignation.

Stock falls in pre-market trading; November 17 earnings report unaffected

As questions over Jensen Huang's position developed, NVIDIA's stock price has been under pressure for several days. Reuters reported that after the resignation announcement, the company's stock fell more than 10% at one point in US pre-market trading, with the market concerned about whether the leadership change would affect NVIDIA's cooperation with major AI clients, as well as future product development strategy.

NVIDIA has confirmed that its fiscal year 2027 third-quarter earnings report, originally scheduled for release on November 17 (US time), will be published as planned, and the arrangements for the earnings conference call will also remain unchanged. This will be the first major quarterly earnings release faced by the company's management since Jensen Huang's departure.

articles.summary_en: This is a news report about NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang suddenly resigning as CEO after 33 years, amid scandal rumors, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. The article covers the leadership change, the appointment of a new board chair, the swirling controversy, and the stock market reaction.

articles.title: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數增至20萬人　多於預期
articles.summary: 美國上星期申請失業救濟嘅人多咗，去到20萬人，多過大家估計。

levels.text: 美國上個星期申請失業救濟嘅人增加到20萬，多過大家估嘅。比上個星期多9000人。呢兩個月淨係有兩個星期有20萬人咁多。4個星期平均都有19.5萬人。到10月31日，仲喺度攞緊救濟嘅人少咗，得返169.7萬人，比上個星期少2萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week, the number of people in the US applying for unemployment benefits increased to 200,000, more than what everyone estimated. That's 9,000 more than the previous week. In the past two months, only two weeks have had as many as 200,000 people. The 4-week average is also 195,000 people. As of October 31, the number of people still receiving benefits decreased, down to only 1.697 million people, 20,000 fewer than the previous week.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

levels.text: 上星期美國申請失業救濟的人數上升到20萬，比大家預期的多。這個數字比前一星期多9000人。過去兩個月，只有兩星期的人數達到20萬。4星期平均數字超過19.5萬人。另外，到10月31日為止，仍在領取救濟金的人減少到169.7萬，比之前少了2萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week, the number of people applying for unemployment benefits in the US rose to 200,000, more than everyone expected. This figure is 9,000 more than the previous week. In the past two months, only two weeks have reached a number of 200,000. The 4-week average figure exceeds 195,000 people. Additionally, as of October 31, the number of people still receiving benefits decreased to 1.697 million, 20,000 fewer than before.

levels.text: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數增至20萬人，多於預期，按星期增加9000人，近兩個月只有兩星期達到20萬人水平。 4星期平均值維持於逾19.5萬人。 截至10月31日止，該星期持續申領失業救濟人數減至169.7萬人，按星期減少2萬人。
levels.text_en: The number of new weekly unemployment benefit claims in the US rose to 200,000 last week, higher than expected, an increase of 9,000 week-over-week. In nearly the past two months, only two weeks have reached the 200,000 level. The 4-week average remains above 195,000. As of the week ending October 31, the number of continuing unemployment benefit claims decreased to 1.697 million, down 20,000 week-over-week.

articles.title: 北部都會區金融諮詢工作小組開會　討論北都大學城可行融資安排
articles.summary: 金管局同銀行公會一齊開會，傾北部都會區點樣用錢同埋大學城嘅發展計劃。

levels.text: 金管局同銀行公會開咗個會，傾北部都會區嘅錢點樣用。佢哋話想幫啲大學同園區借錢更容易，仲會教局講北都大學城嘅新計劃。銀行話會幫手支持呢個大學城同埋附近嘅地方一齊發展。
levels.text_en: The Monetary Authority and the Banking Association held a meeting to discuss how money for the Northern Metropolis should be used. They said they want to make it easier for universities and parks to borrow money, and also had the Education Bureau present the new plans for the Northern Metropolis University Town. The banks said they would help support the development of the university town together with the nearby areas.

levels.text: 金管局與銀行公會共同舉行會議，討論北部都會區的融資安排。他們建議修改規則，把部分大學及園區公司列為「本地公營單位」，這樣可以降低銀行的資金成本，令這些機構更容易取得銀行貸款。教育局亦在會上介紹了北都大學城的最新發展，包括大學城的定位、校園規劃及財務安排。與會的銀行代表表示，未來會提供合適的金融服務，支持大學城與鄰近產業園區一同發展。
levels.text_en: The Monetary Authority and the Banking Association jointly held a meeting to discuss financing arrangements for the Northern Metropolis. They proposed amending the rules to classify some universities and park companies as 'local public sector entities', which would lower banks' cost of funds and make it easier for these institutions to obtain bank loans. The Education Bureau also presented the latest developments on the Northern Metropolis University Town at the meeting, including the university town's positioning, campus planning, and financial arrangements. Bank representatives attending said they would provide suitable financial services in the future to support the joint development of the university town and nearby industrial parks.

levels.text: 金管局與銀行公會共同成立的「北部都會區金融諮詢工作小組」舉行第3次會議。發展局、教育局、財經事務及庫務局、創新科技及工業局，以及25間參與工作小組的銀行代表均有出席。 金管局為進一步加強銀行業對北都項目的融資支持，建議修訂《銀行業（資本）規則》，指定包括11間專上院校及3間園區公司的政府關聯機構為「本地公營單位」，有助降低銀行資金成本，促進相關機構獲取銀行融資，以加速落實北都項目。金管局擬於明年首季向立法會提交有關修訂案，以期第2季生效。 教育局在會議上介紹了北都大學城最新發展，包括3個大學城定位、校園區發展及相關財務安排。 與會者就北都大學城的可行融資安排，例如貸款及公私營合作等，進行討論及提供專業建議。工作小組參與銀行表示，將提供合適金融服務，支持北都大學城與周邊產業園區及項目協同發展。
levels.text_en: The 'Northern Metropolis Financial Advisory Working Group', jointly established by the Monetary Authority and the Banking Association, held its 3rd meeting. Representatives from the Development Bureau, Education Bureau, Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau, as well as 25 banks participating in the working group, all attended. To further strengthen the banking sector's financing support for Northern Metropolis projects, the Monetary Authority proposed amending the Banking (Capital) Rules to designate government-linked institutions—including 11 post-secondary institutions and 3 park companies—as 'local public sector entities', which would help lower banks' cost of funds and facilitate these institutions in obtaining bank financing, thereby accelerating the implementation of Northern Metropolis projects. The Monetary Authority plans to submit the relevant amendment to the Legislative Council in the first quarter of next year, aiming for it to take effect in the second quarter. The Education Bureau presented the latest developments on the Northern Metropolis University Town at the meeting, including the positioning of the 3 university towns, campus area development, and related financial arrangements. Attendees discussed and provided professional advice on feasible financing arrangements for the Northern Metropolis University Town, such as loans and public-private partnerships. Banks participating in the working group said they would provide suitable financial services to support the coordinated development of the Northern Metropolis University Town with surrounding industrial parks and projects.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong's Monetary Authority and the Banking Association held a meeting about financing for the Northern Metropolis, a major development zone, focusing on how to help universities and business parks there get bank loans more easily, including plans for a new 'university town'.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】黃仁勳真是被精液沖昏頭腦？
articles.summary: 輝達老闆黃仁勳出軌嘅情人黃樂，佢間公司俾人懷疑幫中國走私晶片，搞到輝達股價大跌。

levels.text: 輝達嘅黃仁勳認咗出軌，情人係黃樂。他們在台北酒吧認識，後來黃樂的公司被指和中國有關。有人話佢哋仲走私晶片去中國添。消息一出，輝達股價就下跌了好多，市值蒸發咗好幾百億美元。
levels.text_en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair, with the other person being Huang Le. They met at a bar in Taipei, and later Huang Le's company was said to be connected to China. Some people say they even smuggled chips to China. After the news broke, Nvidia's stock price fell a lot, and its market value evaporated by several hundred billion dollars.

levels.text: 輝達行政總裁黃仁勳承認對妻子不忠，對象是中國女子黃樂。兩人在台北酒吧認識後，黃樂的公司Megaspeed被指和中國政府有關聯，可能協助走私輝達晶片到中國，規避美國出口管制。這消息傳出後，輝達股價大跌，市值蒸發超過二千億美元。有報道指，黃樂原本是中國遊戲公司第七大道的人馬，後來透過空殼公司掩飾股權，最終順利取得輝達認證成為合作夥伴。
levels.text_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, with the other party being a Chinese woman named Huang Le. After the two met at a bar in Taipei, Huang Le's company Megaspeed was alleged to be linked to the Chinese government, possibly helping smuggle Nvidia chips to China to evade US export controls. After this news came out, Nvidia's stock price plunged, and its market value evaporated by more than $200 billion. According to reports, Huang Le was originally connected to the Chinese gaming company 7Road (Di Qi Dadao), and later used shell companies to disguise ownership, eventually successfully obtaining Nvidia certification to become a partner.

levels.text: 人類史上最窮奢極侈的一次出軌，毫無疑問，就是輝達CEO黃仁勳偷吃「女共諜」黃樂了。自黃仁勳承認對妻子不忠後，輝達股價盤前一度插水近5%，市值一下子蒸發二千億美元，「也許就因為要成全她」——那個一夜成名的大陸女子黃樂（Alice Huang）。 一般人出軌是不值得評論的，但黃仁勳不是一般人。誰握住他的春袋，誰就握住全球科技命脈，足以影響美、中國力競爭。女主角黃樂，雖不像古希臘海倫，擁有「使千艘戰艦齊發的容貌」，但絕對有偷運十萬顆晶片的手段。黃仁勳出軌，若僅僅是對妻子不忠，「犯了全天下男人都會犯的錯」，公眾當然不必置喙。我最怕是沒這樣簡單。 黃仁勳跟黃樂的關係，很多人都追溯到2024年6月某夜台北酒吧的一幕。黃樂以新加坡公司Megaspeed高管的身分，跟一群科技業主管在酒吧聚會。據在場的軟體供應商NetThunder行政總裁Parker Schmitt所述，黃樂誇口說：「跟你們打賭，我能把黃仁勳叫來。」不一會，黃仁勳果然穿着他的招牌黑皮衣現身，和眾人一起喝威士忌。NetThunder隨後將黃仁勳、黃樂等人的合照發布於LinkedIn。 以上耐人尋味的故事，其實不是今天才有的新聞，早見於去年10月《紐約時報》刊出的報道〈A Mystery C.E.O. and Billions in Sales: Is China Buying Banned Nvidia Chips?〉。當時記者更翻查了馬來西亞貿易紀錄，指出那次台北酒吧聚會後幾星期內，Megaspeed就開始穩定接收價值數以百萬美元計的輝達最先進晶片。 然而再看真一點，輝達跟Megaspeed的合作，早於2023年已悄悄展開。Megaspeed表面上是新加坡公司，實際上跟中共有千絲萬縷關係——它的前身，就是中国網絡遊戲公司「第七大道（7Road）」，股東包括中共中央政府及多個地方政府。2022年10月，拜登政府開始實施晶片出口管制；五個月後，第七大道就將旗下的新加坡業務分拆，出售予黃樂控制的海外公司Huang Le Ltd.，並更名為Megaspeed。黃樂出任董事總經理，另一名董事叫Cang Yang。 2023年11月，Huang Le Ltd.將Megaspeed 全部股權轉讓給新成立的新加坡空殼公司 Swiftdata，黃樂和Cang Yang辭任董事。這家Swiftdata的唯一股東及Megaspeed的唯一董事，叫Tan Yong Pong（Tan應該是姓陳），又名James Tan，是一名五十多歲、常駐上海的新加坡籍男子，背景神秘。股權轉讓僅四天後，Megaspeed便獲輝達正式認證為Nvidia Cloud Partner。由此可見，黃樂應該在2023年已搭上黃仁勳，同時布局金蟬脫殼，把Megaspeed股權轉給一個明顯只掛名的James Tan。 2024年2月，Megaspeed在馬來西亞
levels.text_en: Without a doubt, the most extravagantly excessive affair in human history is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's infidelity with the 'female Chinese spy' Huang Le. Since Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, Nvidia's pre-market stock price plunged nearly 5% at one point, wiping out $200 billion in market value in an instant — 'perhaps all for her sake' — the mainland Chinese woman Huang Le (Alice Huang) who became famous overnight. Ordinary people's affairs aren't worth commenting on, but Jensen Huang is no ordinary person. Whoever holds his 'spring bag' holds the lifeline of global technology, enough to affect the US-China power rivalry. The female lead, Huang Le, may not have Helen of Troy's 'face that launched a thousand ships,' but she absolutely has the means to smuggle out a hundred thousand chips. If Jensen Huang's affair were merely infidelity to his wife, 'a mistake all men in the world make,' the public naturally wouldn't need to comment. What I fear most is that it's not that simple. Many people trace Jensen Huang's relationship with Huang Le back to a scene one night in June 2024 at a bar in Taipei. Huang Le, in her capacity as an executive of the Singapore company Megaspeed, was partying with a group of tech industry executives at the bar. According to Parker Schmitt, CEO of software vendor NetThunder who was present, Huang Le boasted: 'I bet you I can get Jensen Huang to come here.' Not long after, Jensen Huang indeed showed up wearing his signature black leather jacket, and drank whiskey with everyone. NetThunder later posted a group photo of Jensen Huang, Huang Le and others on LinkedIn. This intriguing story is actually not news that broke today — it was already reported last October in a New York Times article titled 'A Mystery C.E.O. and Billions in Sales: Is China Buying Banned Nvidia Chips?' At the time, the reporter had checked Malaysian trade records and pointed out that within weeks of that Taipei bar gathering, Megaspeed began steadily receiving Nvidia's most advanced chips worth millions of dollars. However, looking more closely, Nvidia's cooperation with Megaspeed had quietly begun as early as 2023. Megaspeed is ostensibly a Singapore company, but in reality has deep ties to the Chinese Communist Party — its predecessor was the Chinese online gaming company '7Road,' whose shareholders included the CCP central government and several local governments. In October 2022, the Biden administration began implementing chip export controls; five months later, 7Road spun off its Singapore business and sold it to Huang Le's offshore company, Huang Le Ltd., renaming it Megaspeed. Huang Le became managing director, with another director named Cang Yang. In November 2023, Huang Le Ltd. transferred all of Megaspeed's equity to a newly established Singapore shell company called Swiftdata, and Huang Le and Cang Yang resigned as directors. The sole shareholder of Swiftdata and sole director of Megaspeed is a man named Tan Yong Pong (Tan is likely the surname), also known as James Tan, a Singaporean man in his fifties based in Shanghai, with a mysterious background. Just four days after the equity transfer, Megaspeed was officially certified by Nvidia as an Nvidia Cloud Partner. This shows that Huang Le likely already got involved with Jensen Huang in 2023, while simultaneously arranging a 'cicada shedding its shell' scheme — transferring Megaspeed's equity to the clearly nominal James Tan. articles.title: 引進辦稱接觸逾千企業　142重點企業落戶承諾投放840億元
articles.summary: 引進辦話而家已經有142間大公司喺香港開業，仲答應投資840億元同埋整多兩萬幾份好工。

levels.text: 引進辦話，佢哋已經搵咗超過一千間公司。現在有142間大公司在香港開業了。佢哋答應投資840億元，仲會整多兩萬幾份好工。這些公司嘅投資已經超過原本講好嘅數目。新嚟嘅公司有好多係美國、歐洲同韓國嘅，仲有北京、上海同深圳嘅公司。
levels.text_en: The Office for Attracting Enterprises said they have already contacted more than a thousand companies. Now 142 major companies have opened business in Hong Kong. They have promised to invest 84 billion dollars, and will also create more than twenty thousand good jobs. These companies' investments have already exceeded the originally agreed amount. Many of the newly arrived companies are from the US, Europe, and South Korea, and there are also companies from Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen.

levels.text: 引進重點企業辦公室主任任景信表示，他們已經接觸超過一千間企業。現時有142間重點企業落戶香港，承諾投資840億元，並提供約二萬六千七百個高端職位。他說，無論資金或職位數目都已經超標，以首六批企業計算，投資額比承諾多出約三成。他又指，他們會挑選重點企業，仔細了解當中兩三成企業的計劃，並協助它們制定在港發展方案。企業落戶前幾個月已經開始聯絡，跟進時間長達一年以上，期間會為企業配對合適的大學、投資者或商界夥伴。新一批企業中，海外以美國最多，也有歐洲企業，並首次有韓國企業來港；內地企業則來自北京、上海和深圳等城市。人工智能和生命健康科技是兩個主要領域，各佔約三成，金融科技和新能源則各佔一成多。
levels.text_en: Yam King-shing, Director of the Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises, said they have already contacted more than a thousand enterprises. Currently 142 strategic enterprises have settled in Hong Kong, pledging to invest 84 billion dollars and provide about 26,700 high-end positions. He said both the funding amount and the number of jobs have already exceeded targets — looking at the first six batches of enterprises, the investment amount exceeds the pledged amount by about 30%. He also said they carefully select strategic enterprises, gaining in-depth understanding of the plans of about 20-30% of them, and help them formulate development plans for Hong Kong. Contact begins several months before enterprises settle, with follow-up lasting over a year, during which they match enterprises with suitable universities, investors, or business partners. Among the new batch of enterprises, the US has the most from overseas, there are also European enterprises, and for the first time there are Korean enterprises coming to Hong Kong; mainland enterprises come from cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen. Artificial intelligence and life/health technology are the two main sectors, each accounting for about 30%, while fintech and new energy each account for just over 10%.

levels.text: 引進重點企業辦公室上月引進第7批重點企業來港，共有18間企業。引進辦主任任景信表示，引進辦至今已接觸過千間企業，現時共有142間重點企業落戶香港。 任景信出席本台節目《星期六問責》表示，在港落戶的重點企業，共承諾投放達840億元，會製造約26700個高端就業機會。引進辦一直監察，以跟進企業發展情況，現在無論在投入資金或就業機會都超標完成，如果以首6批重點企業來看，資本投入已超越預計的承諾數字約三成。 他表示，引進辦會精挑細選重點企業，在接觸的企業中，與大約兩三成有深入了解，並協助擬定在港發展計劃。在過程中，在企業落戶前幾個月聯絡，跟進時間差不多一年以上。引進辦人員亦會與他們商討項目具體進展，再進行配對相應政策或不同在港持份者，包括大學、投資者或商界，為他們配對夥伴，希望確保有實際產業貢獻。 至於新一批引進企業，他表示，以海外來說，以美國最多，亦有歐洲企業，並首次有韓國的重點企業來港。內地方面，有來自包括北京、上海及深圳等。人工智能及生命健康科技屬於兩個比較大的板塊，各佔大約三成，金融科技及新能源等各有一成多。
levels.text_en: The Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises brought in the 7th batch of strategic enterprises to Hong Kong last month, totaling 18 companies. Director Yam King-shing said the office has so far contacted over a thousand enterprises, and currently a total of 142 strategic enterprises have settled in Hong Kong. Speaking on the program "Saturday Accountability," Yam said the strategic enterprises that have settled in Hong Kong have collectively pledged to invest up to 84 billion dollars, and will create about 26,700 high-end job opportunities. The office has been continuously monitoring to follow up on enterprise development, and now both the capital invested and job opportunities have exceeded targets — looking at the first 6 batches of strategic enterprises, the capital invested has already exceeded the pledged target figure by about 30%. He said the office carefully selects strategic enterprises; among the enterprises contacted, they have gained deep understanding of about 20-30% of them, and help them draft development plans for Hong Kong. In this process, contact is made several months before the enterprise settles, with follow-up lasting almost a year or more. Office staff also discuss the specific progress of projects with them, then match them with corresponding policies or various stakeholders in Hong Kong, including universities, investors, or the business sector, pairing them with partners, hoping to ensure real industrial contribution. As for the new batch of enterprises, he said that among overseas ones, the US has the most, there are also European enterprises, and for the first time there are Korean strategic enterprises coming to Hong Kong. On the mainland side, there are enterprises from places including Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen. Artificial intelligence and life/health technology are the two relatively large sectors, each accounting for about 30%, while fintech and new energy each account for just over 10%.

articles.title: 【漫婷思理】十年前，十年後 – 許穎婷
articles.summary: 黃之鋒十五歲就同朋友組織學民思潮，為香港爭取民主，十年之後卻被判坐十年監，令好多人好難過。

levels.text: 十年前，黃之鋒先得十五歲，佢同朋友一齊搞學民思潮，為香港爭取民主。今日佢俾人判咗十年監，好多人都好難過。我哋睇住佢由細路仔到而家，心入面好唔舒服。但我們要諗吓，自己仲可以為佢、為香港做啲乜嘢。
levels.text_en: Ten years ago, Joshua Wong was only fifteen years old when he and his friends formed Scholarism to fight for democracy in Hong Kong. Today he has been sentenced to ten years in prison, and many people feel very sad. We watched him grow from a kid to now, and our hearts feel very uncomfortable. But we need to think about what we can still do for him and for Hong Kong.

levels.text: 黃之鋒十五歲就同朋友組織學民思潮，反對國民教育，為香港爭取民主。十年之後，法院判他十年監禁。很多人讀到這個消息都感到難過，不知道可以做些什麼。作者認為，大家除了傷心，更應該想想自己可以為香港做什麼，才不會讓這份感動白白浪費。
levels.text_en: At fifteen, Joshua Wong organized Scholarism with friends, opposing national education and fighting for democracy in Hong Kong. Ten years later, the court sentenced him to ten years in prison. Many people felt sad reading this news and didn't know what they could do. The author believes that besides feeling sad, everyone should think about what they can do for Hong Kong, so that this feeling of being moved isn't wasted for nothing.

levels.text: 為了香港的前途，押上自己的前途。 十年。即使早已反覆設想最壞的結果，當刑期真正宣讀出來，那份沉痛根本無從預備。 今天翻看舊日對話，才發現這張照片，原是之鋒在學民思潮解散四周年那天偶然翻出，再傳給我的，我猜他是想拿來取笑我吧。我至今仍記得當年說過的一句蠢話，惹得眾人忍俊不禁。往事歷歷在目，驀然驚覺，照片拍下已是十年前的事。然後，他還要多走十年。 許多香港人最初認識黃之鋒時，他才十五歲。自那時起，他在香港追求民主的道路上，幾乎未曾停步。如今他三十歲，而下一次相見，恐怕已是四十歲。當年那群意氣風發的少年，又有誰能料到，往後的人生竟會走到這般境地？ 反覆刷新新聞頁面，讀了一篇又一篇朋友的專訪與感言，卻始終找不到合適的文字，安放此刻的情緒。我想，許多香港人，這兩天大概都經歷著同樣的失語。 更難的是，身為倡議者，即使同樣被這一記當頭棒喝打得措手不及，仍得設法整理思緒，說出一些能讓人有所思考、有所行動的話。不願公共討論只停留於集體哀傷，更不望這份悲痛最終化作無力，徒留一聲嘆息。 每逢工作中這些不得不收拾心緒、硬著頭皮站出來的時刻，我總忍不住想，當年那麼年輕的黃之鋒，究竟是如何一次又一次做到的？ 所謂失語，並非無話可說。恰恰因為有太多感受、太多話想說，卻又深知現實中的種種掣肘，甚至不確定說出口後，究竟還有多少人在乎。久而久之，滿腔悲憤會在日復一日的生活中慢慢消磨，直至我們以為自己已經釋懷。 但我認識的之鋒，大概會說——有話想說，便設法說出來；有事想做，就應付諸行動。若始終停留於心念，再深切的情感，也終會隨時間淡去，彷彿從未存在。 今天，我們為他憤怒，為他難過；明天醒來，生活卻仍得如常。那些曾經翻湧的情緒，會否又在日常的消磨中漸漸平息，讓我們再次習慣麻木？抑或，我們可以有意識地留住這份觸動，將悲憤化作動力，重新思索自己願意如何度過往後的歲月，又願意為所信之事多走哪一步？ 回想之鋒初露鋒芒，與朋友創立學民思潮、組織反國教，正是因為深信年輕人聲音的份量。那時，一群「毛都未生齊」的中學生，從反國教學會了如何說「不」，繼而思考如何爭取決定自身命運的權利。一步一步走來，不知不覺間，早已將個人的前途與香港的命運緊緊扣連在一起。 黃之鋒用整個青春，執意相信香港的未來應當屬於香港人，相信我們有權決定自己的前途。然而，現實卻如此事與願違。一個為香港人爭取自主命運的人，到頭來，竟被剝奪了選擇自己未來的自由。 這是何等諷刺，又何其殘酷。 或許，正因這份難能可貴的真摯與使命感，才更令人心酸。但當我們為他的付出與命途感到痛惜之際，到底除了惋惜與憐憫，我們便再無其他可以為他做的事嗎？若只將他視作一個悲壯的象徵，感念他的犧牲，卻不思考如何同行，那麼這份感動，又能留下甚麼？ 真正的同行，並非要求人人作出同等犧牲，而是願意在各自的崗位與人生道路上，重新思量自己還能為他、為香港的未來付出甚麼。 的確，時移世易，
levels.text_en: For the future of Hong Kong, he staked his own future. Ten years. Even though one had already imagined the worst outcome over and over, when the sentence was actually read out, the grief was something no amount of preparation could soften. Today, looking back through old conversations, I discovered this photo — it turns out Joshua had dug it up by chance on the fourth anniversary of Scholarism's dissolution and sent it to me, probably to tease me. I still remember the silly thing I said back then that made everyone burst out laughing. The past feels so vivid, and yet I suddenly realize this photo was taken ten years ago. And now, he still has ten more years to go. Many Hong Kong people first came to know Joshua Wong when he was just fifteen. From that time on, he barely paused in his pursuit of democracy for Hong Kong. Now he is thirty, and the next time we meet, he will likely be forty. Back then, who among that group of spirited young people could have imagined their lives would come to this? I kept refreshing the news page, reading interview after interview and statement after statement from friends, yet I couldn't find the right words to hold this moment's emotions. I think many Hong Kong people have been experiencing this same speechlessness these past two days. What's harder is that, as an advocate, even though I too was caught off guard by this heavy blow, I still have to organize my thoughts and find words that can make people think and act. I don't want public discussion to remain only at collective mourning, nor do I want this grief to turn into helplessness, leaving only a sigh. Whenever work forces me to compose myself and brace myself to step forward, I can't help but wonder how the young Joshua Wong managed to do this again and again. This so-called speechlessness isn't because there's nothing to say — quite the opposite, there's too much feeling, too much to say, yet one is also keenly aware of real-world constraints, even uncertain how many people would still care after the words are spoken. Over time, that surging grief and anger slowly wears away in daily life, until we think we've let go of it. But the Joshua I know would probably say — if you have something to say, find a way to say it; if there's something you want to do, act on it. If it remains only a thought, even the deepest feeling will eventually fade with time, as if it never existed. Today we are angry for him, sad for him; tomorrow we wake up and life goes on as usual. Will those stirred emotions gradually settle again in the grind of daily life, making us numb once more? Or can we consciously hold onto this feeling, turn grief and anger into motivation, and rethink how we're willing to spend the years ahead, and what further step we're willing to take for what we believe in? Looking back to when Joshua first came into the spotlight, founding Scholarism with friends and organizing against national education, it was precisely because he believed deeply in the weight of young people's voices. At that time, a group of secondary school students who hadn't even grown their first facial hair learned from opposing national education how to say "no," and then went on to think about how to fight for the right to decide their own fate. Step by step, without realizing it, they had already tightly linked their personal futures to the fate of Hong Kong. Joshua Wong used his entire youth insisting on the belief that Hong Kong's future should belong to Hong Kong people, that we have the right to decide our own future. Yet reality turned out so contrary to that wish. A person who fought for Hong Kong people's right to decide their own fate ended up being stripped of the freedom to choose his own future. How ironic, and how cruel this is. Perhaps it is precisely this rare sincerity and sense of mission that makes it all the more heartbreaking. But as we grieve over his sacrifice and fate, is there really nothing else we can do for him besides pity and regret? If we only see him as a tragic symbol, moved by his sacrifice but never thinking about how to walk alongside him, then what will this feeling of being moved leave behind? True solidarity doesn't require everyone to make the same sacrifice, but rather a willingness, in each person's own position and path in life, to rethink what more they can still give for him, and for the future of Hong Kong. Indeed, times have changed,

It looks back exactly ten years to when he, at age fifteen, co-founded the student group Scholarism (學民思潮) to oppose national education and fight for democracy in Hong Kong.

articles.title: 休假行山5小時「未覆家長微信」遭解僱！助教留900張加班截圖怒告
articles.summary: 南京一個助教放假去行山，冇覆到家長嘅微信，結果俾公司解僱，佢依家攞住九百張截圖去告公司。

levels.text: 盧小姐喺假期去行山，五個鐘頭冇睇電話。一位重要的客戶搵佢唔到，十分生氣。公司話佢做錯，仲要全部人每三個鐘睇一次電話。幾日後，她被踢出工作群組，權限都被取消咗。公司解僱咗佢，話佢外洩資料同埋講大話。佢唔服氣，攞住九百張截圖去告公司，想討番應得嘅錢。
levels.text_en: Ms. Lo went hiking during a holiday and didn't look at her phone for five hours. An important client couldn't reach her and got very angry. The company said she did something wrong, and then required everyone to check their phones every three hours. A few days later, she was removed from the work group chats and her access permissions were cancelled. The company fired her, saying she leaked information and lied. She was unhappy about this, and using nine hundred screenshots, she is suing the company to get the compensation she deserves.

levels.text: 南京一間教育公司的保研助教盧女士，在休息日去行山五小時，沒有看工作手機。當時一名被視為重要客戶的家長在微信群組問功課問題，五小時都沒人回覆，於是向公司主管投訴。盧女士下山後，多名主管致電斥責她，公司群組內也公開批評她。同一晚，她的組長宣布新規定，要求所有員工即使放假，也要每三小時看一次手機。幾日後，盧女士被踢出所有工作群組，電腦系統的權限也被取消。公司其後正式解僱她，指她在辦公室處理私人事務、外洩內部截圖、並在網上發布不實言論。盧女士不服，保留九百張截圖作證據，並向南京市棲霞區勞動人事爭議仲裁委員會申請仲裁，要求公司賠償雙倍遣散費及拖欠的加班費。
levels.text_en: Ms. Lo, a teaching assistant at an education company in Nanjing handling postgraduate recommendation matters, went hiking for five hours on her day off without checking her work phone. At the time, a parent considered an important client asked a homework question in the WeChat group, and after five hours with no reply, complained to the company's management. After Ms. Lo came down the mountain, several managers called to scold her, and she was also publicly criticized in the company group chat. That same night, her team leader announced a new rule requiring all employees to check their phones every three hours even on days off. A few days later, Ms. Lo was removed from all work group chats, and her access to the computer system was also cancelled. The company then formally fired her, claiming she handled personal matters in the office, leaked internal screenshots, and posted false statements online. Ms. Lo disagreed, kept nine hundred screenshots as evidence, and applied for arbitration with the Nanjing Qixia District Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Committee, demanding double severance pay and unpaid overtime wages.

levels.text: 休假行山停應機5小時 被指得罪VIP客戶 據內地媒體 《揚子晚報》 報道，盧女士於2026年3月中旬入職「南京必研好輕鬆教育科技有限公司」，擔任保研助教一職。雙方簽署的合約為標準工時制，每星期工時不超過40小時，並保證每周至少享有1天休息。 今年10月17日下午2時許，適逢盧女士的輪休日，她選擇前往山區健行，考慮到山區網絡訊號欠佳，她並未攜帶專用工作手機。然而在該段時間內，1名被公司視為「重量級客戶」的家長，在微信服務群內諮詢學業事宜，因長達5小時未獲解答，隨即向機構主管表達不滿。 組長要求員工：盡量每隔3小時查看1次手機 當晚下山後，盧女士隨即接獲多名主管的密集電話斥責，並在各個內部工作群組中遭受公開批評。同日晚上8時許，其直屬組長更在群內臨時頒布「新規定」，要求全體員工即使在休息日，「也必須盡量每隔3小時查看1次手機」。 權限突遭封禁再被解僱 翻出900張截圖自保 爭議在隨後數天迅速惡化，至10月23日晚，盧女士發現自己被無預警剔除出所有工作通訊群，其內網辦公系統權限亦全數遭註銷。10月25日，公司正式向她送達《解除勞動合同通知書》，列出的解僱理由包括：在辦公室處理個人事務、將內部溝通截圖外洩侵犯隱私，以及涉嫌在公眾平台發布「不實言論」。 截圖證明深夜、清晨及公休日被迫處理工作 至10月28日，盧女士正式向南京市棲霞區勞動人事爭議仲裁委員會遞交申請，依法追討違法解除合約的雙倍賠償金（2N）及長期拖欠的加班費。
levels.text_en:
Headline: Took five hours off-grid while hiking on a day off, accused of offending a VIP client, resulting in dismissal; teaching assistant kept 900 overtime screenshots and is suing in anger.

According to mainland media outlet Yangtze Evening News, Ms. Lo joined 'Nanjing Biyan Haoqingsong Education Technology Co., Ltd.' in mid-March 2026 as a postgraduate-recommendation teaching assistant. Both parties signed a standard-hours contract, stipulating no more than 40 working hours per week and guaranteeing at least one rest day per week.

At around 2pm on October 17 this year, which happened to be Ms. Lo's scheduled rest day, she chose to go hiking in a mountainous area. Considering the poor network signal there, she did not bring her dedicated work phone. However, during that time, a parent regarded by the company as a 'heavyweight client' asked about academic matters in the WeChat service group, and after going unanswered for five hours, expressed dissatisfaction to the organization's management.

Team leader's demand: employees should check their phones roughly every 3 hours
That evening after coming down the mountain, Ms. Lo immediately received a barrage of phone calls from multiple managers scolding her, and was publicly criticized in various internal work group chats. That same night at around 8pm, her direct team leader issued a 'new rule' in the group chat on the spot, requiring all staff to 'check their phones roughly every 3 hours' even on rest days.

Access suddenly blocked, then dismissed — 900 screenshots dug up for self-protection
The dispute rapidly worsened over the following days. By the evening of October 23, Ms. Lo discovered she had been removed without warning from all work communication groups, and all her access to the internal office system had been revoked. On October 25, the company formally delivered a 'Notice of Termination of Labor Contract' to her, listing reasons for dismissal including: handling personal matters in the office, leaking internal communication screenshots in violation of privacy, and allegedly posting 'false statements' on public platforms.

Screenshots prove she was forced to handle work late at night, early morning, and on rest days
On October 28, Ms. Lo formally submitted an application to the Nanjing Qixia District Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Committee, seeking lawful double compensation (2N) for wrongful termination of contract, as well as long-owed overtime pay.

articles.title: 美國中期選舉　兩州參議院候選人得票非常接近　暫未能推算結果
articles.summary: 美國有兩個州嘅參議院選舉，兩黨得票好接近，仲未知邊個贏。

levels.text: 美國中期選舉，部分州仍在點票。密西西比州同阿拉斯加州嘅參議院選舉，兩黨候選人得票非常接近。在密西西比州，民主黨的科洛姆暫時領先共和黨的海德史密斯。喺阿拉斯加州，共和黨嘅沙利文同民主黨嘅佩爾托拉，得票都好接近。現在仍未有結果，大家都要等所有選票點完先知道。不過路透社話，民主黨已經攞到參議院過半議席。
levels.text_en: In the US midterm elections, some states are still counting votes. In the Senate elections in Mississippi and Alaska, the two parties' candidates have very close vote counts. In Mississippi, Democrat Espy is currently leading Republican Hyde-Smith. In Alaska, Republican Sullivan and Democrat Peltola have very close vote counts too. There's still no result now, and everyone has to wait until all votes are counted to know. However, Reuters says the Democratic Party has already secured a majority of Senate seats.

levels.text: 美國中期選舉仍在點票。密西西比州和阿拉斯加州的參議院選舉，兩黨候選人票數非常接近，傳媒暫時無法估計結果。在密西西比州，民主黨的科洛姆暫時領先共和黨現任參議員海德史密斯，差距不到一個百分點。當地還有幾千張臨時選票未點完，要到本月十日才完成。密西西比法律沒有自動重新點票的規定，但候選人可以向法院申請重新點票。阿拉斯加州方面，現任共和黨參議員沙利文和民主黨候選人佩爾托拉的票數也相差很少，目前約七成選票已點完。路透社報道，即使不計這兩個州，民主黨預計已經取得參議院過半議席。
levels.text_en: Vote counting is still underway in the US midterm elections. In the Senate elections in Mississippi and Alaska, the two parties' candidates have extremely close vote counts, and media outlets are temporarily unable to estimate the results. In Mississippi, Democrat Espy is currently leading Republican incumbent Senator Hyde-Smith, with a gap of less than one percentage point. There are still several thousand provisional ballots left to count locally, which won't be completed until the 10th of this month. Mississippi law does not have a provision for automatic recounts, but candidates can apply to the courts for a recount. In Alaska, the vote counts between incumbent Republican Senator Sullivan and Democratic candidate Peltola are also very close, with about 70% of votes currently counted. Reuters reports that even without counting these two states, the Democratic Party is expected to have already secured a majority of Senate seats.

levels.text: 美國中期選舉，部分州的點票工作仍在進行，其中密西西比州和阿拉斯加州的參議院選舉，民主共和兩黨候選人得票非常接近，多間美國傳媒都暫時未能推算結果。 在密西西比州，綜合多間美國傳媒統計，民主黨參議員候選人科洛姆，以不足一個百分點的得票率差距，領先共和黨對手、現任參議員海德史密斯。 美聯社報道，當地仍有數千張臨時選票未完成清點，這些選票將在本月10日前完成計算。報道指，密西西比州法律不設自動重新點票的程序，但候選人可以尋求法院頒令重新點票。 阿拉斯加州的參議院選舉同樣未有明確結果。綜合多間美國傳媒統計，現任參議員、共和黨的沙利文，以及民主黨候選人佩爾托拉，得票率亦相差少過一個百分點。阿拉斯加是最後一個結束投票的州分，數據顯示目前大約有七成選票完成清點。 路透社就報道，不計這兩個州，預料民主黨都已經掌握參議院過半議席。
levels.text_en: In the US midterm elections, vote counting is still underway in some states, including the Senate elections in Mississippi and Alaska, where Democratic and Republican candidates have extremely close vote counts, and several US media outlets have been temporarily unable to project the results. In Mississippi, according to compiled statistics from several US media outlets, Democratic Senate candidate Espy leads Republican opponent, incumbent Senator Hyde-Smith, by a margin of less than one percentage point. The Associated Press reports that there are still several thousand provisional ballots locally yet to be counted, and these ballots will be fully tallied by the 10th of this month. The report notes that Mississippi law does not have an automatic recount procedure, but candidates can seek a court order for a recount. The Alaska Senate race also has no clear result yet. According to compiled statistics from several US media outlets, incumbent Senator, Republican Sullivan, and Democratic candidate Peltola also have vote shares differing by less than one percentage point. Alaska is the last state to finish voting, and data shows approximately 70% of votes have been counted so far. Reuters reports that, not counting these two states, the Democratic Party is expected to have already secured a majority of Senate seats.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】張劍虹訪問觀後感
articles.summary: 前《蘋果日報》社長張劍虹提早出獄，喺電視度話自己後悔，但大家都知真正被改造嘅唔係佢，而係香港。

levels.text: 張劍虹係前《蘋果日報》社長，佢因為官司坐咗監。本來要坐到2028年，而家提早出獄了。佢上電視話自己後悔2019年嘅事，仲話做中国人好驕傲。好多人睇完都覺得，呢種認罪冇用。大家心入面都知道，真正被改造嘅唔係佢，而係香港。
levels.text_en: Cheung Kim-hung is the former president of Apple Daily. He went to prison because of a lawsuit. He was originally supposed to stay until 2028, but now he's been released early. He went on TV saying he regrets the 2019 events, and also said he's proud to be Chinese. Many people who watched felt that this kind of confession is useless. Everyone knows in their hearts that the one who was truly 'reformed' is not him, but Hong Kong itself.

levels.text: 張劍虹是前《蘋果日報》社長，因為一宗官司被判監禁，原本要關到2028年。他最近獲准提早釋放，並以「更生人士」身份參加深圳交流團，接受官方媒體訪問。他在鏡頭前說自己後悔2019年的抗爭，又說做中国人感到驕傲。作者認為，這類「認罪」宣傳其實沒有效果，只會令人更反感。文章又提到唐英傑和作家楊絳、錢鍾書、季羨林在政治運動中的經歷，指出思想改造往往徒勞無功，甚至適得其反。結尾認為，張劍虹能夠出獄是好事，因為被改造的不是他，而是香港本身。
levels.text_en: Cheung Kim-hung is the former president of Apple Daily. Because of a lawsuit he was sentenced to prison, originally to be held until 2028. He was recently granted early release, and as a 'rehabilitated person' he joined a Shenzhen exchange tour and gave an interview to official media. On camera he said he regrets the 2019 protests, and also said he feels proud to be Chinese. The author argues that this kind of 'confession' propaganda is actually ineffective and only makes people more disgusted. The article also mentions Tong Ying-kit, as well as the writers Yang Jiang, Qian Zhongshu, and Ji Xianlin and their experiences during political campaigns, pointing out that thought reform is often futile and can even backfire. In conclusion, the author believes it's a good thing that Cheung Kim-hung was released, because what was truly 'reformed' is not him, but Hong Kong itself.

levels.text: 被指「勾結外國勢力」而坐牢、原定2028年3月出獄的前《蘋果日報》社長張劍虹，近日獲提早釋放，更以懲教署「更生人士」身分參加深圳交流團，接受黨媒訪問。張劍虹除了讚揚中国科技發展，聲稱身為中国人而驕傲外，還做了一場「電視認罪」，為2019年抗爭表示懊悔。 類似的「思想改造」宣傳，近年在香港已見怪不怪。例如2020年因駕駛插有「光時」旗電單車撞向警員的唐英傑，被控煽動分裂及恐怖活動，本來判囚九年，其後多次被安排出鏡懺悔，據報道也獲准提前釋放了。搞這類政治宣傳，看網民反應，就知道根本徒具形式，實際影響是零——若非令人更鄙視這個政權的話。 共產黨統治中國後，一直鍥而不捨搞「思想改造」，但從實事求是的唯物主義角度去看，靠恐嚇和強迫的「改造」往往只會適得其反。楊絳在《幹校六記》第六篇〈誤傳記妄〉中，回顧自己和錢鍾書在「解放」前夕選擇去留的心路歷程，就反省了自己經歷多年政治運動及思想改造後，內心所發生的微妙變化。 楊絳坦言決定留下來，並非因為有多高的政治覺悟，而是出於對祖國和同胞「痛癢相關，息息相連」的感情。錢鍾書更時常引用柳永詞「衣帶漸寬終不悔，為伊消得人憔悴」，表達甘願為祖國承受苦難的決心。但經歷了文革浩劫——女婿自殺，夫妻分離——楊絳早就無暇顧念祖國，心態已變成「且求獨善我家，不問其它」。 筆法含蓄的楊絳隨後寫了一句話，值得細味：「解放以來，經過九蒸九焙的改造，我只怕自己反不如當初了。」她當初因愛國而不走，後來家不成家，只盼跟丈夫和女兒團聚，其他事情都來不及關心了。「反不如當初」五字，實隱含深刻的諷刺：政治運動本來要改造知識分子思想，結果非但沒有令人變得更高尚，反而把他們原有的理想和愛國情懷都銷磨殆盡。 「思想改造」既然無效（「從小便洗腦」則另作別論），「電視認罪」又被視為笑話，為什麼還要做呢？說穿了，無非是旨在侮辱。再想一想文革。季羨林在《牛棚雜憶》寫道，1978年他重遇一名十多年未見的老幹部，對方劈頭便說：「古人說：『士可殺，不可辱。』『文革』證明了：『士可殺，亦可辱。』」說罷哈哈大笑。從笑聲中，季羨林聽見老幹部心中積壓的痛苦。 季羨林指出，文革批鬥大會和審訊中的發言，「百分之九十九是誣蔑、捏造、羅織、說謊」。在這種政治環境下，事實不再重要，重要的是能否編造出足以置人於死地的罪名。更令人心寒的是，浩劫過後，不少曾殘害無辜的人皆身居高位，還發了大財。在《牛棚雜憶》尾聲，季羨林進一步追問：文革究竟有沒有給中国人留下教訓？他的回答斬釘截鐵：「沒有，一點也沒有。」 在九十年代初殺青的《牛》中，季羨林明言文革並未真正過去，更表示擔憂中国人將會重蹈覆轍。季羨林沒猜錯，但大概想不到他年最有文革遺風的地區之一，居然是曾經最開放、最自由、最國際化的前英殖民地。張劍虹能夠提早出獄，終究是好事。無論他在鏡頭前講什麼，明理者都不會失望或奇怪，因為大家心知肚明：被改造的不是他，是香港。

Cheung Kim-hung, former president of Apple Daily, was imprisoned for allegedly 'colluding with foreign forces' and was originally due to be released in March 2028. He has recently been granted early release, and under the status of a 'rehabilitated person' from the Correctional Services Department, he joined a Shenzhen exchange tour and gave an interview to party media. Besides praising China's technological development and claiming to be proud to be Chinese, Cheung also performed a 'televised confession,' expressing remorse for the 2019 protests.

Such 'thought reform' propaganda has become unsurprising in Hong Kong in recent years. For example, Tong Ying-kit, who in 2020 drove a motorcycle flying a 'Liberate Hong Kong' flag into police officers and was convicted of inciting secession and terrorism, was originally sentenced to nine years but has since been repeatedly put on camera to repent, and reportedly has also been granted early release. Judging by netizens' reactions to this kind of political propaganda, it's clear that it's purely a formality with essentially zero real effect — if it doesn't make people despise the regime even more.

Since the Communist Party took power in China, it has persistently pursued 'thought reform.' But from a practical, materialist point of view, 'reform' achieved through intimidation and coercion often backfires. In the sixth essay of 'Six Chapters from a Cadre School,' titled 'A Mistaken Account, Refuted,' Yang Jiang recalls her and Qian Zhongshu's deliberations over whether to stay or leave on the eve of the Communist 'liberation,' reflecting on the subtle changes in her inner feelings after years of political campaigns and thought reform.

Yang Jiang candidly admits that her decision to stay was not due to any lofty political consciousness, but out of feelings of being deeply and intimately connected to her homeland and compatriots. Qian Zhongshu often quoted a line from Liu Yong's poetry: 'My robe grows looser, yet I never regret it; for her I'll waste away and grow thin,' expressing his willingness to endure hardship for his motherland. But after the catastrophe of the Cultural Revolution — their son-in-law's suicide, husband and wife separated — Yang Jiang no longer had the capacity to think about the motherland; her mindset had shifted to 'just hoping to protect my own family, not concerned with anything else.'

In her characteristically restrained style, Yang Jiang then wrote a line worth savoring: 'Since liberation, after being steamed and roasted nine times over through reform, I fear I have instead become worse than I was at the start.' She originally stayed because of patriotism, but later, with her family broken, all she hoped for was reunion with her husband and daughter — she had no time to care about anything else. The phrase 'worse than at the start' carries a profound irony: political campaigns were meant to reform intellectuals' thinking, but the result was not that people became nobler — instead, their original ideals and patriotic feelings were ground down to nothing.

articles.title: 褲襠藏鳥！古巴男特製內褲走私10隻珍禽　被捕後辯稱：私人使用
articles.summary: 一個古巴男人用特製內褲喺褲襠藏10隻雀仔，想由古巴帶去美國，俾海關捉到。

levels.text: 卡斯蒂略由古巴飛去美國邁阿密，他說自己是去探親。海關見他條褲好奇怪，就帶他去檢查。佢嘅內褲裡面有6個盒，裝住10隻雀仔。佢話啲雀係自己用嘅，但不肯講邊度攞嚟嘅。而家佢俾人告上法院。
levels.text_en: Castillo flew from Cuba to Miami in the US, saying he was visiting relatives. Customs officers thought his pants looked strange, so they took him to be checked. Inside his underwear were 6 boxes containing 10 birds. He said the birds were for his own use, but refused to say where he got them. He has now been charged in court.

levels.text: 卡斯蒂略從古巴哈瓦那飛往美國邁阿密，他在海關表格上聲稱只是探親，並否認攜帶任何動植物。海關人員發現他神情緊張，腰部也有異常隆起，於是帶他去搜身檢查。人員發現他的內褲裡縫了黑色口袋，藏着6個膠盒，裡面共有10隻活鳥，包括8隻黃面草雀和2隻藍彩鵐，兩者都是非法野生動物貿易的常見物種。卡斯蒂略拿不出合法進口證明，只說這些鳥是自己使用，之後就拒絕透露走私來源和動機。目前，美國聯邦法院已以走私貨物罪名起訴他。
levels.text_en: Castillo flew from Havana, Cuba to Miami, USA. On the customs form he claimed he was only visiting relatives, and denied carrying any animals or plants. Customs officers noticed he looked nervous and that there was an unusual bulge at his waist, so they took him for a body search. Officers found black pockets sewn into his underwear, hiding 6 plastic containers holding a total of 10 live birds, including 8 yellow-faced grassquits and 2 blue grosbeaks, both common species in illegal wildlife trade. Castillo could not produce proof of legal import and only said the birds were for his own use, then refused to reveal the source or motive for the smuggling. He has now been charged by a US federal court with smuggling goods.

levels.text: 男子褲襠「異常隆起」惹疑 綜合外媒報道，事發於10月4日，涉案男子卡斯蒂略（Alberto Hernandez Castillo）乘搭航班由古巴哈瓦那飛抵邁阿密。他在填寫海關申報表時聲稱此行僅為探親，並否認攜帶任何野生動植物。然而，海關人員在例行提問時，發現卡斯蒂略神色慌張，且其腰部及骨盆前方有不尋常的隆起，遂將他帶往安全查驗區作進一步搜身檢查。 內褲特製袋藏6個容器 打開驚見10隻走私鳥 海關人員深入檢查後，驚見卡斯蒂略的內褲內側特別縫製了黑色口袋，裡面藏著6個透明圓柱形塑膠容器。這些容器均以膠帶嚴密包裹，開口處更黏上黑色網狀布料以防禽鳥逃脫。容器內共裝有10隻活鳥，包括8隻黃面草雀（Yellow-faced Grassquit）以及2隻藍彩鵐（Blue Grosbeak），2者均屬非法野生動物貿易中的熱門物種。 涉事男表示珍禽供「私人使用」 拒絕交代走私來源 卡斯蒂略未能提供任何合法進口野生動物的證明文件。被捕後他僅向調查人員聲稱這些珍禽是供「私人使用」，隨後行使保持沉默的權利，拒絕交代走私來源及動機。卡斯蒂略目前已被美國聯邦法院以走私貨物罪名起訴。 （綜合）
levels.text_en: Man's suspicious bulge in his pants raises suspicion. According to foreign media reports, the incident occurred on October 4. The man involved, Alberto Hernandez Castillo, flew from Havana, Cuba to Miami. When filling out the customs declaration form, he claimed the trip was only to visit relatives and denied carrying any wildlife. However, during routine questioning, customs officers noticed Castillo appeared nervous and that there was an unusual bulge at his waist and front pelvic area, so they took him to a security screening area for further body search. Special pockets in underwear hid 6 containers; 10 smuggled birds found inside. After a thorough search, officers discovered black pockets specially sewn into the inside of Castillo's underwear, containing 6 transparent cylindrical plastic containers. These containers were all tightly wrapped in tape, with black mesh fabric glued over the openings to prevent the birds from escaping. The containers held a total of 10 live birds, including 8 yellow-faced grassquits and 2 blue grosbeaks, both popular species in the illegal wildlife trade. Man claims the birds were for 'personal use,' refuses to reveal smuggling source. Castillo could not provide any documentation proving legal import of wildlife. After his arrest, he only told investigators that the rare birds were for 'personal use,' then exercised his right to remain silent, refusing to disclose the source or motive behind the smuggling. Castillo has now been charged by a US federal court with smuggling goods. (Compiled report)

articles.summary: 美國星期二投票選議員，好多人已經提早投咗票，白宮都做定準備等民主黨可能攞到國會。

levels.text: 星期二係美國嘅中期選舉日，好多人已經提早投咗票，人數比四年前多好多。星期六在弗吉尼亞州，票站外排晒長龍，有人想揀一個會聽市民心聲嘅議員，唔想俾大公司話事。白宮已經做定準備，因為民主黨好可能攞到國會嘅控制權。
levels.text_en: Tuesday is the US midterm election day. Many people have already voted early, far more than four years ago. On Saturday in Virginia, long lines formed outside polling stations. Some people wanted to choose a lawmaker who would listen to ordinary citizens' voices, rather than being controlled by big corporations. The White House has already prepared, because the Democratic Party is very likely to gain control of Congress.

levels.text: 星期二是美國中期選舉的投票日。數據顯示，提前投票人數超過五千二百萬，比四年前增加不少，學者預計今年投票率可能超過二零二二年。弗吉尼亞州的提前投票已經結束，不少選民希望當選的議員能聽取普通市民的意見，不受大企業左右。調查顯示，大部分選民認為經濟和生活成本是最重要的議題，近半數選民關注移民問題。民主黨需要在眾議院和參議院各多贏四席，才能奪得國會控制權。目前民調顯示民主黨有望贏得眾議院，但參議院選情仍然緊張。據報白宮已經準備好應對民主黨可能重新掌控國會的局面。
levels.text_en: Tuesday is voting day for the US midterm elections. Data shows that more than 52 million people have voted early, a significant increase from four years ago, and scholars expect this year's turnout may exceed that of 2022. Early voting in Virginia has already ended; many voters hope that the elected lawmakers will listen to the opinions of ordinary citizens and not be controlled by big corporations. Surveys show that most voters consider the economy and cost of living the most important issues, while nearly half of voters are concerned about immigration. Democrats need to win four more seats each in the House and the Senate in order to take control of Congress. Current polls show Democrats are likely to win the House, but the Senate race remains tight. It is reported that the White House has already prepared for the possibility that Democrats may regain control of Congress.

levels.text: 星期二是美國中期選舉投票日，佛羅里達大學選舉實驗室的追蹤數據顯示，超過5200萬名美國選民已經提前投票，高於四年前中期選舉的提前投票人數。美國阿克西奧斯新聞網站引述政治學者預計，整體投票率可能超越2022年。 星期六是弗吉尼亞州提前現場投票的最後一日，票站外排起長龍。有民眾希望當選的政客，能夠傾聽一般市民的聲音，而且不受大企業影響。亦有選民認為，全國的選舉結果難以預測，希望當選者能夠採取接近中間派的立場，代表沉默的大多數。 美聯社與芝加哥大學聯合創辦的公共事務研究中心，在10月中旬發布的調查顯示，分別有八成半和八成四選民，把經濟和生活成本列為中期選舉最重要議題之一，四成半選民認為移民問題是最重要議題之一。 民主黨需要在國會眾議院和參議院分別淨增加四個議席，才能夠推翻共和黨目前在眾議院218比214，以及參議院53比47的微弱多數席位。民調顯示，民主黨有望贏得眾議院控制權，參議院的選情仍然難分難解。 路透社引述白宮官員和知情人士透露，白宮已用了幾個月時間，為民主黨可能重掌國會做準備，制定計劃以應付民主黨對政府發起調查的同時，繼續透過行政權力推進特朗普議程的重要部分。
levels.text_en: Tuesday is the voting day for the US midterm elections. Tracking data from the University of Florida Election Lab shows that more than 52 million American voters have already voted early, higher than the early voting turnout in the last midterm election four years ago. The US news website Axios cites political scientists predicting that overall turnout may exceed that of 2022. Saturday was the last day of in-person early voting in Virginia, and long lines formed outside polling stations. Some members of the public hope that the politicians elected will be able to listen to the voices of ordinary citizens and not be influenced by big corporations. Some voters also believe that the national election results are hard to predict, and hope that winning candidates will take positions close to the center, representing the silent majority. A survey released in mid-October by the Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research, jointly founded by the Associated Press and the University of Chicago, shows that 85% and 84% of voters respectively listed the economy and cost of living as among the most important issues in the midterm elections, while 45% of voters considered immigration one of the most important issues. Democrats need to gain a net increase of four seats each in the House of Representatives and the Senate in order to overturn the Republicans' current narrow majorities of 218 to 214 in the House and 53 to 47 in the Senate. Polls show Democrats are likely to win control of the House, while the Senate race remains too close to call. Reuters, citing White House officials and sources familiar with the matter, reports that the White House has spent months preparing for the possibility that Democrats may regain control of Congress, drawing up plans to deal with potential Democratic investigations into the government while continuing to advance key parts of Trump's agenda through executive power.

articles.summary_en: This article reports on early voting ahead of the 2022 US midterm elections, with high turnout figures compared to previous years, and on reports that the White House has been preparing for the possibility that Democrats regain control of Congress.

levels.text: 你撳咗「確認預約」。你可能好驚，不知道點算。又驚人哋知你去見心理學家。其實不需要準備太多嘢，帶住現在嘅心情去就得。你可以寫低幾個重點，例如「瞓唔着」「同屋企人嗌交」。著得舒服啲，因為傾談通常係五十到九十分鐘。入到診所要填啲表格，之後心理學家會問你點解嚟。佢哋會保密，你可以問清楚範圍。
levels.text_en: You clicked 'confirm appointment.' You might be scared and not know what to do. You might also worry that others will find out you're seeing a psychologist. Actually, you don't need to prepare much — just go with how you're feeling now. You can write down a few key points, like 'can't sleep' or 'argued with family.' Dress comfortably, since sessions usually last fifty to ninety minutes. At the clinic you'll need to fill out some forms, and then the psychologist will ask why you came. They will keep things confidential, and you can ask them to clarify the scope of that.

levels.text: 你終於按下了『確認預約』。心裡可能很緊張，不知道第一次見心理學家會發生什麼事。其實不用準備得像面試一樣完整，只要帶着現在的心情去就可以。你可以先寫下幾個重點，例如『最近失眠』或『和家人吵架』，幫助自己記得想說的話。第一次見面通常維持五十至九十分鐘，穿得舒服一點會更自在。到診所後，你需要填寫一些基本資料，有時還會填寫情緒問卷，例如PHQ-9或GAD-7，這些只是幫助心理學家初步了解你的情況。心理學家通常會先說明保密原則：你所說的內容會保密，除非涉及你或他人的安全。接着他們會問你為什麼決定來見面、這個情況持續了多久，以及你的日常生活、睡眠、食慾和人際關係有什麼變化。
levels.text_en: You finally pressed 'confirm appointment.' You might feel very nervous, not knowing what will happen at your first meeting with a psychologist. Actually, you don't need to prepare as thoroughly as for a job interview — just go with however you're feeling now. You can first write down a few key points, like 'recently can't sleep' or 'argued with family,' to help yourself remember what you want to say. The first meeting usually lasts fifty to ninety minutes, and dressing comfortably will help you feel more at ease. After arriving at the clinic, you'll need to fill out some basic information forms, and sometimes mood questionnaires like the PHQ-9 or GAD-7 — these are just to help the psychologist get an initial understanding of your situation. The psychologist will usually first explain the confidentiality principle: what you say will be kept confidential, unless it involves safety concerns for you or others. Then they will ask why you decided to come, how long this situation has lasted, and what changes have occurred in your daily life, sleep, appetite, and relationships.

levels.text: 你終於按下了「確認預約」。 也許你猶豫了很久。也許你在凌晨三點反覆搜尋「 臨床心理學家 」，看了十幾個網頁，卻沒有一個真正告訴你：走進那間房之後，到底會發生什麼事。 你不是唯一有這種感覺的人。一項綜合了 144 個研究、共 90,189 名參與者的系統性回顧發現，在各種與污名化相關的求助障礙中，「怕別人知道自己去看心理學家」是最常被提及的一種（Clement et al., 2015）。 這篇文章不會叫你「 放鬆 」或者「不要想太多」。它會帶你走一遍大致的流程——從預約那一刻，到你走出診所的那個下午。每位臨床心理學家的做法可能略有不同，但以下是一個常見的經歷。 預約之後、赴約之前 你可能已經開始想像各種情景：心理學家會不會一直盯著你？你需要把所有事情都講出來嗎？如果講到一半哭了怎麼辦？ 先處理最實際的部分。 你不需要準備一份「完美的自述」。 很多人以為第一次見面要像面試一樣，把自己的問題條理分明地陳述一遍。不是的。臨床心理學家受過專業訓練，懂得引導對話。你只需要帶著你現在的狀態去就好。 可以帶一些簡單的筆記。 如果你擔心緊張到忘記想說的事，寫下兩三個重點就夠了。不需要長篇大論，幾個關鍵詞就好——「最近失眠」「和家人吵架」「工作 壓力 」。 穿讓自己舒服的衣服。 這聽起來很瑣碎，但第一次的會面通常持續 50 到 90 分鐘，你會希望自己坐得自在。 還有一件事：如果你在門口轉了三圈才走進去，那也完全正常。 走進診所的那一刻 你推開門。 接待處通常很安靜。你可能需要報到、填一些基本資料表格——有些診所會請你填簡短的情緒問卷（例如 PHQ-9 或 GAD-7），這些問卷不是考試，沒有「答錯」這回事，它們只是幫助心理學家初步了解你目前的狀態。 然後你坐在等候區。也許你會拿起手機滑一下，也許你會盯著牆上的畫。無論哪種，都沒關係。 不少人說，當心理學家來接你的時候，會發現他們的語氣比想像中平靜，笑容比想像中自然。 初次評估面談：他們到底會問什麼？ 第一次見面通常以「初次評估」（initial assessment）為主。這不是治療的開始，而是雙方互相了解的過程。 不少心理學家會先解釋保密原則。 一般而言，你說的內容都是保密的，除非涉及你或他人的即時安全風險。這是受專業守則保障的。如果你擔心「被人知道」，可以在見面時主動問清楚保密的範圍。 接下來，他們通常會問你一些問題。不是審問，更像是一場有方向的對話。以下是一些常見的例子： 「是什麼讓你決定來見我？」 很多心理學家會以類似的問題開場。你不需要有一個戲劇性的答案。「最近覺得很累，不知道為什麼」已經是一個很好的起點。 「這個情況持續多久了？」 他們想了解你的困擾是近期的變化，還是困擾你好一段時間的事。 「日常生活受到什麼影響？」 睡眠 、食慾、工作表現、人際關係——這些都是評估的常見範圍。 「你之前有沒有接受過心理支援？」
levels.text_en: You finally pressed 'confirm appointment.' Maybe you hesitated for a long time. Maybe at 3am you repeatedly searched 'clinical psychologist,' looked at a dozen webpages, yet none really told you what actually happens once you walk into that room. You're not alone in feeling this way. A systematic review combining 144 studies with a total of 90,189 participants found that among various stigma-related barriers to seeking help, 'fear that others will find out I'm seeing a psychologist' was the most commonly mentioned barrier (Clement et al., 2015). This article won't tell you to 'relax' or 'not think too much.' It will walk you through the general process — from the moment you book the appointment to the afternoon you walk out of the clinic. Each clinical psychologist's approach may differ slightly, but here is a common experience. After booking, before the appointment: You may already be imagining various scenarios — will the psychologist stare at you the whole time? Do you need to say everything? What if you cry halfway through talking? First, deal with the practical matters. You don't need to prepare a 'perfect self-account.' Many people think the first meeting should be like an interview, where you lay out your problems in an organized way. That's not the case. Clinical psychologists are professionally trained and know how to guide the conversation. You just need to show up as you currently are. You can bring some simple notes. If you're worried you'll get too nervous and forget what you wanted to say, writing down two or three key points is enough. No need for lengthy paragraphs — a few keywords will do, like 'recently can't sleep,' 'argued with family,' 'work stress.' Wear something that makes you comfortable. This may sound trivial, but the first meeting usually lasts 50 to 90 minutes, and you'll want to be able to sit comfortably. One more thing: if you circle the entrance three times before going in, that's completely normal too. The moment you walk into the clinic: You push open the door. The reception area is usually quiet. You may need to check in and fill out some basic information forms — some clinics will ask you to fill in brief mood questionnaires (such as the PHQ-9 or GAD-7). These questionnaires aren't a test; there's no such thing as a 'wrong answer' — they just help the psychologist get an initial sense of your current state. Then you sit in the waiting area. Maybe you'll scroll on your phone, maybe you'll stare at a painting on the wall. Either way is fine. Many people say that when the psychologist comes to fetch them, their tone turns out calmer than expected, and their smile more natural than expected. The initial assessment interview: what exactly will they ask? The first meeting is usually focused on an 'initial assessment.' This isn't the start of treatment, but a process for both sides to get to know each other. Many psychologists will first explain the principle of confidentiality. Generally, what you say is kept confidential, unless it involves an immediate safety risk to you or others. This is protected by professional codes of conduct. If you're worried about 'people finding out,' you can proactively ask about the scope of confidentiality during the session. After that, they will usually ask you some questions. It's not an interrogation, but more like a directed conversation. Here are some common examples: 'What made you decide to come see me?' Many psychologists will open with a similar question. You don't need a dramatic answer. 'I've been feeling very tired lately and don't know why' is already a good starting point. 'How long has this been going on?' They want to understand whether your difficulty is a recent change or something that has troubled you for a while. 'What impact has this had on your daily life?' Sleep, appetite, work performance, relationships — these are common areas covered in the assessment. 'Have you received psychological support before?'

articles.summary_en: This is a guide explaining what to expect when going to a first appointment with a clinical psychologist in Hong Kong, from booking the appointment to the actual conversation. It walks through common worries, practical preparation tips, and the kinds of questions a psychologist typically asks at an initial assessment.

articles.title: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數減至19.4萬人　低於預期
articles.summary: 美國上星期新申請失業救濟嘅人少咗，仲好過大家預期。

levels.text: 美國上星期申請失業救濟嘅人有19.4萬，少過預期，比上星期少咗1000人。自9月中以來，呢個數字大多數都在20萬人以下，接近57年嚟嘅低位。4星期嘅平均數跌到19.7萬人，比上星期少咗1250人。到10月17日為止，仍然申領救濟的人有170.1萬，都比預期少，比上星期少了2.1萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week, 194,000 people in the US applied for unemployment benefits, fewer than expected, and 1,000 fewer than the previous week. Since mid-September, this number has mostly been below 200,000, close to a 57-year low. The 4-week average dropped to 197,000, which is 1,250 fewer than the previous week. As of October 17, there were still 1.701 million people continuing to receive benefits, also fewer than expected, 21,000 fewer than the previous week.

levels.text: 美國上星期新申請失業救濟人數為19.4萬，低於市場預期，較上星期減少1000人。自9月中以來，這數字大部分時間都低於20萬，接近57年來最低水平。4星期平均數下降至19.7萬，較上星期減少1250人。截至10月17日，仍在領取救濟的人數為170.1萬，同樣低於預期，較上星期減少2.1萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week, new applications for unemployment benefits in the US were 194,000, below market expectations, a decrease of 1,000 from the previous week. Since mid-September, this number has mostly been below 200,000, close to the lowest level in 57 years. The 4-week average fell to 197,000, a decrease of 1,250 from the previous week. As of October 17, the number of people still receiving benefits was 1.701 million, also below expectations, a decrease of 21,000 from the previous week.

levels.text: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數19.4萬人，低於預期，按星期減少1000人。自9月中以來，數據大多數處於20萬人以下，貼近約57年低位。 4星期平均值減至約19.7萬人，按星期減少1250人。 截至10月17日止，該星期持續申領失業救濟人數170.1萬人，低於預期，按星期減少2.1萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week's new unemployment benefit claims in the US were 194,000, below expectations, down 1,000 week-over-week. Since mid-September, the data has mostly been below 200,000, near a roughly 57-year low. The 4-week average fell to about 197,000, down 1,250 week-over-week. For the week ending October 17, continuing unemployment claims were 1.701 million, below expectations, down 21,000 week-over-week.

articles.title: 24歲內地女赴泰見男網友　上車10分鐘遭送泰緬邊境　跳車撿回一命
articles.summary: 一個24歲內地女仔去泰國見網友，差啲俾人送去泰緬邊境，好彩佢跳車走得切。

levels.text: 有一個24歲嘅內地女仔去咗泰國見網友。佢落機十分鐘後就搵唔到人。原來係男網友搵人嚟接佢，再用私家車送佢去泰緬邊境。佢好醒目，喺車度跳咗落去，啲村民救低咗佢。呢兩個月入面已經係第二宗咁嘅事了。
levels.text_en: A 24-year-old mainland woman went to Thailand to meet an online friend. Ten minutes after she got off the plane, she couldn't be found. It turned out the male online friend had sent someone to pick her up, who then used a private car to send her to the Thailand-Myanmar border. She was clever and jumped out of the car, and villagers rescued her. This is already the second such incident in the past two months.

levels.text: 一名24歲內地女子早前在社交平台認識一名男網友，對方邀她到泰國見面。她9月28日抵達曼谷機場後，有人話是受男網友所託來接機，並安排她上車。怎料私家車竟連夜將她送往泰緬邊境。她在途中跳車逃生，幸好被村民發現並出手相助。泰國警方其後聯合多個部門調查，發現犯罪集團熟悉達府邊境山路，又不斷更換車輛逃避檢查。這已是兩個月內第二宗同類人口販運案。今年8月，一名29歲女子同樣被網友誘騙到泰國，再被綁架押往邊境，最後都係跳車逃生，4名疑犯全部落網。使館已經發出安全提示，提醒大家小心防範。
levels.text_en: A 24-year-old mainland woman had previously met a man online on a social media platform, and he invited her to meet him in Thailand. After she arrived at Bangkok airport on September 28, someone claiming to have been sent by the male online friend picked her up and arranged for her to get into a car. Unexpectedly, the private car drove through the night to send her to the Thailand-Myanmar border. She jumped out of the car to escape along the way, and was fortunately found and helped by villagers. Thai police then worked with multiple departments to investigate, and found that the criminal gang was very familiar with the border mountain roads in Tak province, and kept changing vehicles to avoid checkpoints. This is already the second similar human trafficking case in two months. In August this year, a 29-year-old woman was similarly lured to Thailand by an online friend, then kidnapped and taken toward the border, and she also escaped by jumping from the car; all four suspects were caught. The embassy has issued a safety notice reminding everyone to be careful.

levels.text: 落地10分鐘即失聯 私家車連夜直奔泰緬邊界 據內地 《大河報》 報道，泰國旅遊警察披露的案情，受害女子此前在社交平台上結識1名自稱身在泰國的男子，在對方甜言蜜語的邀約下，於9月28日抵達曼谷素萬那普國際機場（Suvarnabhumi Airport），當時1名聲稱受男網友委託的接機人員到來，將女子安排坐到1輛私家車上。 女子果斷跳車逃生 途經村民發現相助 國旅遊警察接報後迅速聯合多部門展開調查，發現涉案犯罪網絡極其熟悉達府（Tak）邊境的偏僻小路，且在長途押送過程中多次更換車輛，以躲避警方關卡查緝。 2個月內第2宗人口販運 使館發布安全預警 這已是過去2個月內第2宗同類案件。據 《環球網》 報道，早在今年8月23日，1名原定赴新加坡攻讀碩士學位的29歲中國籍女子，同樣被在網上認識的「友人」勸誘轉往泰國旅遊，隨後在當地遭4名泰籍男子綁架並押往泰緬邊境。該名女子亦是在被押送途中冒險跳車逃生，涉案4名男子最終全數落網。
levels.text_en: She lost contact 10 minutes after landing, as a private car sped overnight straight to the Thailand-Myanmar border. According to the mainland outlet 'Dahe Daily,' citing details disclosed by Thai tourist police, the victim had previously met a man on a social media platform who claimed to be in Thailand. Lured by his sweet talk, she arrived at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi International Airport on September 28. At that time, a person claiming to have been entrusted by the male online friend came to pick her up and arranged for her to get into a private car. The woman decisively jumped from the moving car to escape, and was discovered and helped by villagers along the way. After receiving the report, Thai tourist police quickly coordinated with multiple departments to investigate, and discovered that the criminal network involved was extremely familiar with the remote paths along the Tak province border, and repeatedly changed vehicles during the long-distance transport to evade police checkpoints. This is already the second human trafficking case of this kind in the past two months, with the embassy issuing a safety alert. According to 'Global Network' (Huanqiu Wang), as early as August 23 this year, a 29-year-old Chinese woman who had originally planned to go to Singapore to pursue a master's degree was similarly persuaded by an online 'friend' to change her trip to Thailand instead. She was then kidnapped locally by four Thai men and taken toward the Thailand-Myanmar border. This woman also took the risk of jumping from the vehicle to escape during the transport, and all four men involved were eventually caught.

articles.summary_en: A 24-year-old mainland Chinese woman flew to Thailand to meet a man she had met online, but soon after landing she was picked up and driven toward the Thailand-Myanmar border, apparently as part of a trafficking scheme; she escaped by jumping from the moving car. This is reported as the second such case in two months.
